verdict.rationale: Zep is an API-first SaaS, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only shows static code snippets in guides (e.g., client.graph.edge.delete) and an llms.txt index. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer, playground or runnable examples, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
